problem: Calculate the volume of the parallelepiped spanned by $a=⟨1,-2,1⟩$, $b=⟨2,-4,1⟩$ and $c=⟨0,2,5⟩.$
worked_solution:
The volume of the parallelepiped spanned by three vectors is given by the absolute value of their triple product.

First, we compute the triple product:

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot (b\times c) & =|\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 2 & -4 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}-4 & 1 \\ 2 & 5\end{aligned}|-(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}|+1\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & -4 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =((-4)\cdot 5-2\cdot 1)+2(2\cdot 5-0\cdot 1)+(2\cdot 2-0\cdot (-4)) \\  & =-22+20+4 \\  & =2\end{aligned}
$$

    

Finally, we take the absolute value. So the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped is

$$
V=|2|=2.
$$
